answer.read: One target is OFF: deals/h is 69.5 on 3 h against a need of 85. v6 is exactly on its line at .845, and the last hour ran 75 deals/h at v .88 on 154 orders/h. Most lost goods visits are 'too dear' (136/h). The 15 newest are fixed or walked-down asks 2-15% above our cap: sergiobuilds sofa 1,276,944 vs 1,248,375 (+2.3%), Kiro729 sofas and beds +5-11%, ovotnwjd-maker beds +11-14%. The only floor knob that reaches them is goods_delta, which can move .01 and is already .01. Taking it to 0 would raise the cap by about 1%, too little to win most of these. The few deals it did win would score v about .77, against F .7674, so they add almost nothing to saved. It would also put v6 at risk under .845, and the operator's order says to revert a move that does that. 'Rejected' (98/h) mostly comes before any offer, so it is not a price problem. 'Grade C claimed' (72/h) is a correct walk. Goods skips rose to 18/h. Five of the 15 newest skips are beds expected at .96, but ovotnwjd-maker's fixed bed asks sit 11-14% above cap, so the visit has almost no chance of a deal and the skip is right. The rest are sofas at .57-.61 and phone accessories, also correct, though two sofa skips at .81 and one at .857 were lost. No move is safe and no move clearly helps, so I hold and let the live A/B decide, as the operator ordered. The knob table still shows take_v .81 and slot_value .03. The ledger and the operator note say .87 and .05, and I report this rather than override what may be an A/B arm.
